# vvm_protection_group (Resource)

Manages a VVM protection group (`/v1/protection-groups`). A protection group binds a set of VMs to a backup policy and declares the consistency model and selector that controls which VMs are included.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `consistency_model` (String) Consistency model for backups in this group. One of `crash` (crash-consistent) or `app` (application-consistent via pre/post hooks).
- `name` (String) Human-readable name for the protection group. Unique within the VVM instance.
- `policy_id` (String) UUID of the `vvm_backup_policy` that governs this group.
- `selector_kind` (String) Kind of VM selector. One of `explicit`, `tag`, or `project`. Controls the shape of `selector_value`.
- `selector_value` (String) JSON payload for the selector. Shape depends on `selector_kind`:

- `explicit`: `{"vm_ids": ["<uuid>", ...]}`
- `tag`:      `{"tag": "<string>"}`
- `project`:  `{"project_id": "<uuid>"}`

Use `jsonencode()` in HCL to build the value.

### Optional

- `skew_policy_override` (String) Per-group override for skew handling. Null inherits from the policy `skew_policy`. One of `flag-and-keep` or `strict-fail`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the protection group (UUID).
- `updated_at` (String) RFC3339Nano timestamp of the last update; used as the ETag / If-Match token.
